candidate_workaround: Anchor live-ledger assertions to evidence that already existed before the recovering method began; never require a method's own future passing witness as a precondition for running its acceptance check.
failure_signature: The first lifecycle-safe assertion still required seven passing witnesses while M07's seventh pass could only be appended after that assertion passed.
recurrence_guard: Set recovery acceptance minima from immutable pre-recovery evidence and test active lifecycle states separately from later promotion.
rollback: Give the circular targeted assertion zero credit, retain M07 as candidate, and append no passing witness until a noncircular bounded check succeeds.
scope_boundary: Owner-local noncircular test recovery only; no x2, scientific, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Make recovery acceptance independent of its own future witness
trigger_preconditions: A recovery method's proposed acceptance assertion counts append-only witnesses or states that the recovery itself will create.
